title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — September 15, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B5.4 (Peaked September 15, 2026 at 15:09 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 449 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 5 expected

Calm conditions right now. ✨

The Sun looks quiet overall, with broad dark coronal-hole regions and bright activity concentrated near the limbs; no clear large outward structure is visible.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
